extracted.intended_audience: professional communicators (public relations and corporate communications professionals), press-release writers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and evaluating press releases according to IABC's Global Standards and Code of Ethics, emphasizing strategic alignment, audience engagement, ethics, consistency, and measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication must be strategic - aligned with organizational goals. Press releases should serve a defined business or institutional purpose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie each release to a clear strategic goal or business objective; avoid issuing releases that do not serve a defined institutional purpose or measurable outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication must engage stakeholders. Releases must capture attention and provide value to readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft headlines and lead paragraphs that capture attention; provide information that is useful or compelling to the target audience; engage stakeholders emotionally and intellectually where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listening (two-way communication)
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication is two-way. Press releases should anticipate audience reaction and address stakeholder concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate questions and concerns from stakeholders and incorporate answers or signposts into the release; consider possible responses and how the organization will follow up across channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical (high ethical standards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication must adhere to high ethical standards: truth, transparency, respect for diverse views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure honesty and transparency in messaging, respect for differing perspectives, and alignment with ethical norms of the profession when composing releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistent
rubrics_metrics.description: Messaging must be consistent across channels. Press releases align with web content, social, internal comms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the release's tone, facts, and calls-to-action are consistent with website copy, social posts, and internal communications; maintain consistent brand voice and key messages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytical
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure and improve. Track release performance and refine approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define metrics for evaluation (e.g., media pickups, impressions, clicks, engagement, sentiment) before distribution and use results to refine future releases and strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Truthful
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify facts, avoid misleading framing or omission of material information, correct mistakes promptly, and do not use deceptive practices in release content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster cultural values
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect human dignity, free speech, diverse cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame messages in ways that recognize and respect cultural differences and human dignity; avoid language or claims that demean or silence groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitive to others' beliefs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of and accommodate diverse religious, cultural, or ideological beliefs in wording and timing of releases to avoid unnecessary offense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public interest / Legal compliance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure releases comply with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., securities rules, advertising law); prioritize public interest and lawful disclosure over promotional objectives when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refrain from taking advantage
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't exploit gained information for personal gain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use privileged or non-public information gained through professional roles for private benefit; avoid actions that could be perceived as exploitative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose any relationships, financial interests, or other conflicts that could affect the credibility or objectivity of the release; be transparent about vested interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refuse undisclosed gifts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decline gifts, payments, or incentives from reporters, vendors, or stakeholders when acceptance would create a conflict or require undisclosed influence on messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence (no guaranteed results)
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't guarantee specific results outside their reach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid promising outcomes (e.g., guaranteed coverage or metrics) that cannot be controlled; maintain professional independence and manage stakeholder expectations realistically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honest in their work
rubrics_metrics.description: Be honest about credentials, services, capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represent organizational capabilities, spokespeople' credentials, and services truthfully in releases; do not overstate likely outcomes or expertise.
